svg.text: DevOps System Architecture & Automated CI/CD Pipeline | College Technical Project Specification
Automated Continuous Integration triggering on every push and pull request to 'main' branch
Automated Parallel Test & Build Verification Execution Matrix
Multi-container architecture connected via internal bridge network 'uptimewatch-network' with persistent storage
• location / -> Serves compiled React SPA assets
• Zero CORS issues via internal proxy forwarding
React 18 + Vite Production Single Page App
• WebsiteCard Grid (Badges, Response Time, Check Now)
FastAPI Website Checker asynchronous HTTP prober & status evaluation flow
1. Background scheduler (or manual button) triggers health check
2. Async HTTP GET dispatched with 10s timeout & header user-agent
3. Response evaluated, latency in ms computed, SQLite updated
4. Prometheus metrics exported & React dashboard polled every 15s
